αIO
===========

!!Deprecated

PCL to control temperature in heated tubes and for general I/O. 
The heated tubes should be configured as Tmin=0°C 
(=4 mA) and Tmax=20°C (=20mA)

Program name:
-------------
trailer/devices/alpha2docs/analogout.vls

Port:
-----
/dev/tty/USB0

Display line:
--------

 1. Mode number
 2. Target temperature
 3. Analog Input values for I1 to I4, no separator
 4. Outputs switched on (Position marked with X)

Usage:
-------
 -	Up / Down changes mode /output (0..9)
 -	When OUT = 0 (temperature mode):
    - Use +/- to adjust temperature
    - Press (OK) to start/stop heating
    - Press (ESC) 1s to stop heating
 -	When OUT > 0 (output mode):
    - Press (+) to switch relay (OUT) on
    - Press (-) to switch relay (OUT) off
    - Press (ESC) to switch all relays off

Troubleshooting:
---------------
This device should usually have no problems. In case of a communictation error:
 - stop program by pressing (OK) and (ESC) for three seconds
 - navigate in the menu to serial communication
 - enable serial communication
 - do the same for Î±Valves
 - unplug and plug the yellow power cord


IO-Settings
-----------
Inputs 1..8 are configured as analog input
Output 1 switches the YSI600R on and off
